review.method: Contractor assistant visually inspected all ten fixed RGB checkpoint tiles before any M3H detector/approach inference. Corrected projected boxes to visible target extents; no candidate omitted.
review.scope: Selected target-checkpoints only, not exhaustive labels or human certification. Cyclist vehicle boxes cover visible rider/bicycle aggregate; person targets cover visible person. Partly truncated/overlapping vehicles and dark people are retained as hard cases. Physical approach labels remain unchanged.
review.selection: Two source intervals fixed solely from pose/cadence metadata; not overlapping M3C-G. Same Boreas recording, not cross-domain validation.
